Annerose Vajra is the main character of Witch of Steel Annerose.

She is half human and half Witch and makes a living by running a detective agency in Amidahara.

This town isn't bad, either. What's especially nice is that there are places that serve good alcohol.
Annerose Vajra


Personality
Annerose is quick to call herself evil. While she isn't actually evil, she is still ruthless when it comes to how she conducts her business. She tricks people worse than her and has her own profit oriented sense of justice. Annerose is confident if not arrogant at times and also fairly lazy and likes to drink and sleep so long she needs to be woken by her servants. She has great instinct but often money or other factors makes her act against it.

As somebody that walks between the twilight of the humans and demons, she is very used to the rules of the twisted Amidahara, be it becoming a slave one day or being killed the other day, and reacts almost bored at times. She can be easy going and is direct, Annerose is forgetful with names and she rarely holds deep grudges, unless it is her arch rival Li Mayfeng.

On a new moon her magic sword grows weaker, and her personality and physical appearance change, looking like a very young teenager. She talks in a more high and mighty way and refers to herself as "us" or "we", but becomes way more shy.

Appearance
Annerose is a woman with long black hair, yellow eyes and pointed ears. She usually wears a latex dress. Annerose sometimes carries a suitcase. In combat, she uses a sword called Vajrayaksa.

On new moons, she takes on the form of a teenager.

History
Annerose Vajra teen
Background
Born of mixed blood to a man from the ruling classes of the Dark World, and a Human woman in Amidahara.

Most of her childhood is unknown, but she made many contacts over the years. She encountered and is an acquaintance of Aishwarya Lai, both know each other since they were children, with Aishwarya teasing her often. Annerose also calls Neu Eazlane grandma and both have a great relationship but have no family ties. Annerose is also not part of the Magicians Association of Neu even if she helps them out from time to time.

At some point, Annerose started to work as an investigator and girl for anything around the borders of Amidahara. Annerose has a shop and house in the better part of town called the Annerose Detective Agency. She does detective work for both Human World and Dark World, mostly about missing person cases. Annerose is known as a world-class magic fencer, holding the legendary dark sword, "Vajrayaksa". A magic blade that eats the evil of its targets.
